reviews.text: I was really disappointed with this. First off it actually stung when I put it on my scalp after I washed my hair - even if only for a second or two but I thought that was weird. Also, I found it really hard to rinse out of my hair afterwards, it just would not come out! Maybe I used too much? I do have very long hair so I’m not sure. I also don’t feel like my hair felt very soft afterwards, if anything it was actually more tangled after washing which was annoying as I don’t usually have tangled hair after washing. It was also quite hard to massage into the scalp upon application as I felt like the product thickened very quickly after reacting with wet hair. Would not recommend honestly, the only thing I liked was the scent and now I have a whole bottle that is useless to me.
reviews.zh: 我真係好失望。首先，我洗完頭之後塗喺頭皮上，佢真係會刺痛——雖然只係一兩秒，但我覺得好奇怪。另外，我發現之後好難沖走，怎樣都沖唔走！可能係我用得太多？我嘅頭髮好長，所以我唔肯定。我亦覺得之後頭髮冇咩柔軟，相反洗完之後更加纏結，好煩，因為我洗完頭通常唔會頭髮纏結。塗抹時亦好難按摩入頭皮，因為我覺得產品一碰到濕頭髮就好快變稠。老實講唔會推薦，我唯一鍾意嘅係味道，而家我有成支對我嚟講冇用嘅產品。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
